motivation_from_training: The matched finalist run spent only 15 of 20 fits and did not nominate a vote. Withholding newly installed encoders led the older library to a complementary vote that lost to the expanded library's leading single on the first training fold and was stronger on two subsequent matched folds. No external validation scores were consulted to design this policy.
intervention: Let a probability vote qualify for scrutiny when it beats every proper subset on the primary training fold and its paired accuracy on that fold is within one paired standard error of the current leader with some actual corrected rows. For metrics other than accuracy retain the previous stricter nomination rule. Before locking, if there is spare budget after reserving complete fresh fold comparisons and refit, spend one opportunity on a currently untried near-competitive method from the anonymous evidence-based action menu. If no such opportunity exists, lock immediately. Reevaluate after each measurement. Eligibility to deploy still requires independent paired improvements over all controls using the existing matched-finalist rule.
comparison: Same raw course archive, installed weights, local generic catalogue, seed, 20 fits including full refits, zero model API, no candidate or previous winner provided. New isolated study. The first four arms remain sealed independently in their registered comparison. Use a 2400-second ceiling to allow compute completion; externally measured wall time is not the endpoint. Report every action, actual training costs and any vote refusal, even if predictions stay unchanged.
external: Read the development validation labels only after freezing the entire new run and reproducing every prediction independently; reuse the earlier score if the newly frozen predictions are byte-identical. The course test and H2 remain sealed.
